rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a clear downward drift with the most recent candle breaking to $41.98 low and closing at $41.99, price is below both VWAP ($42.23) and the 9-EMA ($42.38), and the broader market is under pressure (SPY -0.85%, VIXY +2.35%).
